title: Design spectral response acceleration parameters.
officialText:
Five-percent damped design spectral response acceleration at short periods, SDS, and at 1-second period, SD1, shall be determined from Equation 16-49 and 16-50, respectively:
SDS = 2/3SMS (Equation 16-49)

SD1 = 2/3SM1 (Equation 16-50)
where:
SMS = The MCER spectral response accelerations for short period as determined in Section 1613.5.3. SM1 = The MCER spectral response accelerations for 1-second period as determined in Section 1613.5.3.
